protocol.calibration: Keep the previous luminance point and window selection. Compare the same selected tile with the connected extent.
protocol.region: Use the center half of the selected window and both five-picture flanks, 8-pixel cells, an absolute floor 1.75 and a relative floor 7% of the brightest seed cell. Close one-cell holes, select the connected component at the seed peak and bound the rectangle area.
protocol.development: All 17 prior authored neural positives are a consumed diagnostic. Include the same independently qualified second-family case for exact extent.
protocol.transfer: All ten distinct CREMA-D confirmation sources from the earlier 30 fps paired study. Use only source picture indices, no audio. All files receive a shared new 24 fps 720 by 480 carrier, nearest-neighbor spatial resize also applied to held truth. No new synthesis or independent timing evidence is claimed.
protocol.controls: For each transfer source keep identical, global tone at CRF32, recompression at CRF32 and another source with the same clock. Include the actual ordinary local resampling condition as a real difference.
protocol.acceptance: Original 0.5 time IoU and 0.1 pixel IoU. The diagnostic must recover the exactly timed second-family edit. On transfer retain or add localization on at least 15/20 authored edits over at least seven source groups, add at least three locations over the tile and lose at most one. At most one flag on 30 neutral cases and zero wrong-source admissions.
